candidates.snippet: # [RFC]: Improving MooncakeConnector  MooncakeConnector is the built-in P/D disaggregation KV direct-transfer connector in vLLM. Its underlying Mooncake TransferEngine supports pluggable transports (RDMA/TCP/Ascend direct, etc.), making it **the primary path for P/D disaggregation on non-CUDA platforms**. candidates.title: MLX runner panic with qwen3.6:35b-mlx in Ollama 0.40.x — regression from 0.35.0
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  Hello Ollama team,  I am reporting a reproducible MLX runner crash with `qwen3.6:35b-mlx` on Ollama 0.40.x.  The same production workload and project configuration works correctly with Ollama 0.35.0, but fails with Ollama 0.40.0 and 0.40.1-rc0.  Environment:  * Machine: MacBook Pro M1 Pro * Model: `qwen3.6:35b-mlx` * Ollama endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:11434` * Context length: 65,536 * Maximum output tokens: 16,384 * Temperature: 0.1 * top_p: 0.95 * top_k: 20 * min_p: 0.0
